chart_review_items.title: Introduce selection-only undo and redo
chart_review_items.current_state: Clear-all, removable filter chips, precise ranges, and brush clearing exist; recommendation extends these.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Exploration is reversible without requiring universal application undo.
acceptance_criteria: One completed gesture creates one history step.
Undo/redo restores complete filter state across linked views.
Data replacement resets or rebases history by an explicit policy.
History is bounded; no raw dataset copies per brush update.

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Keep several named analyses without losing state
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Charts, Rows and Calculations are modes within one workspace, with panel state retained.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: These are not named dashboard tabs, independent analysis sessions, dirty-state indicators or navigation history.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: The host parses and validates full-analysis JSON before replacing data and settings; settings-only restore is the embedding path.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Manual JSON restore is not durable named storage, autosave or recovery after closing the browser. Keep the host/package ownership distinction.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

current_assessment.statement: SavedViewsWorkspace serializes the source and tabs to localStorage, duplicates views, exports analyses, and captures bounded checkpoints. SavedDataStructure stores chart filters alongside view settings. BaseChartSettings also stores chart-local restrictions.
current_assessment.evidence_scope: Source inspection only; no fresh application browser proof.
